messages:
maya: Heads up — ap-southeast-1 telemetry has been dark since ~03:10 UTC. Grafana panels show zero-series for node/gpu exports.

devin: Confirming. No Prometheus scrapes from ap-southeast collectors. K8s metrics server still reports node health but agent metrics missing.

jorge: On the nodes I can see fluentd and otel-collector CrashLooping on several hosts. Kube events show 'failed to renew token' errors.

paul: Any recent firewall / security-group changes in that region? We rotated a service-account token for collectors last night as part of credential hardening.

maya: Yeah we rotated collector SA keys at 02:50 UTC via infra-ops-run. Could be timing. But CrashLoop looks like auth failure + liveness failing.

devin: Sample logs from otel-collector: 
```
ERROR auth: failed to fetch token: 401 Unauthorized
ERROR exporter: connection closed
FATAL: failed liveness check: exporter unreachable
```

jorge: Also seeing per-host firewall logs showing dropped egress to internal control-plane IP 10.240.8.9 — the collector tries to reach internal vault for token refresh but the egress rule denies it.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-045 — ap-southeast telemetry blackout. Pager: @maya

maya: Prioritize restoring telemetry so we can make capacity decisions and failover traffic safely. If node-level GPU metrics are missing we might underprovision.

paul: Quick mitigation: temporarily open egress to 10.240.8.9 and vault port 8200 for namespace observability in ap-southeast. I'll add a targeted sg rule.

devin: While that goes in, we should restart the collectors so they re-fetch tokens. Also check kubelet cert expiry which could cause pod restarts.

paul: Pushed SG change and patched NetworkPolicy in ap-southeast namespace: allowed egress to 10.240.8.9/32:8200.

deploy-bot: NetworkPolicy patch applied in ap-southeast — observability namespace updated

jorge: Restarting observability pods: daemonset/fluentd and deployment/otel-collector.

devin: After restart we get metrics back for some nodes but a subset still shows gaps — looks like some collectors recovered but sampling config is set to 0.5 and our storage retention exploded in the moment. Need to cap sampling while backfilling.

maya: Wait, sampling was recently changed? We had a rollout to adjust sampling per-service last week. Who approved config?

jorge: Found CI change: the templated value for OTEL_SAMPLING was mis-evaluated when SA token env var present — resulted in 50% global sampling in ap-southeast. Combined with retries, that caused spikes.

paul: Mitigation steps: 1) set OTEL_SAMPLING=0.1 for ap-southeast, 2) enable heartbeat metric 'collector.heartbeat' at 30s, 3) increase exporter backoff to reduce repeated bursts. Applying now.

devin: Commands used: 
```
kubectl -n observability set env deployment/otel-collector OTEL_SAMPLING=0.1
kubectl -n observability patch deployment/otel-collector --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"otel-collector","env":[{"name":"COLLECTOR_HEARTBEAT","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'
```

maya: Dashboards show heartbeat metrics returning for the restarted collectors. Traces are partial; metrics backfill is ongoing. We're seeing increased ingestion so applying temporary retention caps to avoid cost overrun.

sre-bot: Alert: ingestion spike detected — retention TTL reduced to 1h for raw traces in ap-southeast

paul: Notes on cost/tradeoff: full tracing during recovery will create both network egress and storage spikes. We'll keep 10% sampling after 60m and archive noisy spans.

devin: Agreed. Also adding a guard in the deploy pipeline: CI should fail if OTEL_SAMPLING is unset, null, or >1.0. And a lint rule to prevent empty template interpolation.

jorge: I'll submit two PRs: one in infra that updates the NetworkPolicy template to explicitly whitelist vault/collector IPs and SGs per-region; another in telemetry repo to add heartbeat and fail-fast exporter healthcheck.

maya: Runbook additions: when telemetry flatlines -> 1) check networkpolicy/sg changes, 2) check SA token expiry and vault reachability, 3) check agent crashes and liveness logs. Include commands: 
```
kubectl -n observability get pods -o wide
kubectl -n observability logs deployment/otel-collector -c otel-collector --tail=200
kubectl get networkpolicy -n observability -o yaml
curl -sS http://10.240.8.9:8200/v1/sys/health || echo vault-unreachable
```

paul: Post-incident items: PRs for whitelist and heartbeat, CI guard for OTEL_SAMPLING, add alert rule: if collector.heartbeat missing >90s then page infra-oncall.

devin: Owner assignments: maya (postmortem lead), paul (network/sg fix), jorge (telemetry hotfix + CI), devin (runbook + dashboards). ETA PRs 4h, postmortem draft by EOD.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 status updated: Mitigated

maya: Thanks team. Follow-ups: schedule a small chaos test to validate token rotation + collector egress in staging, and add a cost-safety toggle to automatically reduce sampling during ingestion spikes.

paul: Will add chaos job to the staging playbook and a throttling policy for ingestion spikes.

jorge: Will add unit test to ensure OTEL_SAMPLING cannot be empty and an e2e that asserts collector can reach vault in all regions.

devin: Closing thread. :thumbsup:
